routes.name: A Cheval
routes.overview: Classic easy slab that slants up and left; the holds are rounded and the slab feels dead.

routes.name: B-Boy Stance
routes.overview: Steep roof problem that moves right along the lip on blocky pinches, then cuts back left to top out.
routes.beta: Stand to start, right hand in a small pocket under the roof and the other hand holding an edge along its rim. Shuffle rightward along the rim using blocky pinch holds; once past the upper rim, reverse direction leftward to finish on top.

routes.name: Bad Ladder
routes.overview: Stand start on paired crimps, throw for a jug on a shallow arete, finish up and left.
routes.crux: dyno from twin crimps to a jug on the arete

routes.name: Barn Door Direct Direct
routes.name_search: barn door direct dir direct dir

routes.name: Cranium
routes.overview: Seated start off the block beneath the seam; trend rightward once past the opening move, finishing over jugs.
routes.beta: Start seated on the block below the seam, move rightward after the opening move, and finish on jugs at the top.
routes.location: Sit on the block at the foot of the seam.

routes.name: Crimp Ladder
routes.overview: Stand-start face problem from a seam to the right of the tree, with a dyno for a quartz hold.
routes.location: Face just right of the tree, starting in a seam.

routes.name: Crystal Face
routes.overview: Slab problem up the middle of the face on crystal holds; it eases near the top.
routes.beta: Follow small crystals up the center of the slab; the holds get better and the difficulty drops as you near the top.

routes.name: Easy Rollin'
routes.overview: Rock onto the slab from the right arete and top out left of A Cheval.

routes.name: EDCL
routes.overview: Outstanding tall finger crack followed all the way to the top.

routes.name: Hardman Dentist
routes.overview: Shares its beginning with the first problem here, but after a single move veers right onto crimpy holds within the bulge, finishing up and rightward.
routes.beta: Begin like the neighboring problem, but after a single move head right into the crimps on the bulge and finish by topping out up and to the right.
routes.location: Same start as Pound Crack, then right into the bulge.

routes.name: Hemlock Crack
routes.overview: Excellent easy crack problem from a low jug to the top.
routes.beta: Sit-start from the good jug low on the crack beside the tree, then follow the crack straight to the top.
routes.location: Crack immediately left of the tree, sitting on a jug at its base.

routes.name: High Voltage
routes.overview: Stand-start crack left of the arete with its hard move far above the ground on rounded rock.
routes.crux: high up, well off the ground
routes.location: Crack just left of the arete.

routes.name: Loomit
routes.overview: A sit-start traverse that launches out from underclings, runs along a shelf and a low lip, and tops out on an arete.
routes.beta: Sit down next to the block holding solid underclings. Launch outward onto the shelf, then shuffle rightward along the low rim over the block, then top out via the arete.
routes.location: Right of the block, sitting on good underclings.

routes.name: Bunyan Crack
routes.fa: Sam Slater and Mark Bourque, Summer 1979

routes.name: Crack In The Box
routes.fa: Sam Slater and Mark Bourque, Summer 1979

routes.name: Pine Tree Crack
routes.overview: Low-angle finger crack, often roped as a lead or toprope; the rock feels rounded and dead.

routes.name: Plaque Face
routes.overview: Easy face climb beside the memorial plaque.
routes.location: Face immediately left of the memorial plaque.

routes.name: Pound Back
routes.location: Sit start with the right hand on the sloping arete.

routes.name: Pound Crack (Closed)
routes.overview: A celebrated crack; a block gives access to good jams at the beginning.
routes.beta: Use the block to reach good locks low on the classic crack. A much harder variation skips the block and starts from the lowest holds.
variations: V5: skip the block and start from the bottom-most holds

routes.name: Quincy Market
routes.overview: Shares its low start with Cranium, then goes straight up the seam and jug.
routes.beta: Sit start just like the problem beside it, then follow the seam and the jug directly upward.

routes.name: Re-Fresh
routes.beta: Begin seated upon the ledge then go directly upward, veering right close to the top to reach jugs.

routes.name: Reflection Terminal
routes.overview: Low start in the center of the nose, topping out directly above.

routes.name: Stone Wall
routes.overview: Tall problem from a low start on a flake, straight up and over to a sloping finish.
routes.beta: Start seated, using the flake near the leftmost stretch of the steep section, then climb directly upward and finish over a slopey topout.
routes.location: Flake at the left end of the steep section of the wall.

routes.name: Super Chalk
routes.overview: Low start on a jug, then traverse up and right along the right arete.
routes.beta: Begin seated holding the jug found on the nose's right, then traverse along the right arete, heading up and rightward.

routes.name: The Blot
routes.overview: Straight up the corner from a low edge.

routes.name: The Flakes
routes.overview: Face problem above blocky ground, moving right near the top onto jugs.
routes.landing: blocks below that can turn an ankle

routes.name: The Return of The Blot
routes.overview: Starts like The Blot, then moves rightward to the flake using gastons, a sidepull and crimps before going straight up.
routes.beta: Begin like the problem to its left, then shift rightward onto the flake via gastons, a sidepull and crimps, and go straight up to top out. A harder variation starts standing on the flake roughly four feet up, then goes straight up.
variations: V3: begin standing, four feet up the flake, and go directly upward
routes.location: Same start as The Blot, traversing right to the flake.

routes.name: The Thwart
routes.crux: dyno from a high sidepull to the top

routes.name: Tronic
routes.overview: Begins from a jug inside the crack, then works rightward and upward on blocky holds.
routes.beta: Start from the crack's jug, then traverse rightward and upward on blocky holds.
routes.location: Starts on a jug in the crack.

routes.name: West End
routes.overview: A tall problem on a vertical wall: easy-looking flakes lead to a crimpy topout.
